weather.condition: Fog now, dry and mild later
weather.quip: Open-Meteo has Mill Valley wearing the full coastal-morning cloak at 6 AM: 54°, feels 55°, fog, humidity 99%, and barely-there northeast wind around 1 mph. The fog should give way to a dry, mild day near 80° with only about 1% rain odds, UV around 7.7, sunrise at 6:18 AM, and sunset at 8:12 PM. Friendly morning, sunscreen afternoon, smug evening.
